targets.query: from(bucket: v.bucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "emote_usage_1m" and r._field == "count") |> group(columns: ["channel_login", "provider", "emote_id", "emote_name"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: sum) |> top(n: 20)

from(bucket: v.bucket) |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "emote_usage_1m" and r._field == "count") |> group(columns: ["channel_login", "provider", "emote_id", "emote_name"]) |> increase() |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 25)

from(bucket: v.bucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "emote_usage_1m" and r._field == "count") |> group(columns: ["provider"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: sum)

from(bucket: v.bucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_activity_1m" and (r._field == "chat_count" or r._field == "viewer_max" or r._field == "total_emote_count")) |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max)

from(bucket: v.bucket) |> range(start: -10m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_activity_1m") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "chat_count" or r._field == "total_emote_count" or r._field == "seventv_emote_count") |> last() |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value") |> group(columns:["channel_login", "stream_id"])
